xmldoc.short_description: List the time zone names of a time zone database.

param_input_item.param_description: a string: folder of the time zone database to use. An empty value keeps the current setting.

param_output_item.param_description: a column string array: sorted zone and alias names, 'local' included.
a string: version of the database.

description.p: timezoneslist returns the names of the time zones known to the time zone functions. It is the low-level function behind timezones, which passes the database shipped with Nelson.

When a database is set, the list holds its zones and aliases with the 'local' pseudo-zone, and version is the database version. Without a database, the list holds 'local' and a short list of common zones, and version is 'date-3.0.4-posix'.
When dataPath is given, it becomes the database folder of all the time zone functions for the rest of the session.
